data.name: NoService
data.value: jink's background service is not running. Reinstall jink to fix it.

data.name: OtherVersion
data.value: The background service is from another version of jink. Reinstall jink to fix it.

data.name: FindTakesTime
data.value: Takes a minute or two. Sites may not open meanwhile.

data.name: Kept
data.value: Kept {0}: {1} of {2} checks passed ({3} without jink).

data.name: NothingBlocked
data.value: Nothing is blocked here: every site works without jink.

data.name: NoneHelped
data.value: No strategy did better than without jink.

data.name: NoNetwork
data.value: No network: the sites could not be reached at all.

data.name: OpenAtSignIn
data.value: Open jink when I sign in

data.name: MySitesHint
data.value: Sites jink should also unblock: one per line; links are fine.

data.name: MyIpsHint
data.value: Addresses or networks (1.2.3.0/24) jink should also unblock.

data.name: ExcludedIpsHint
data.value: Addresses or networks jink should leave alone.

data.name: IpListHint
data.value: Also treat traffic to these addresses, whatever the site name.

data.name: GamingHint
data.value: Also unblock game traffic to the servers of the IP list.

data.name: NotSaved
data.value: Some entries are not valid; nothing was saved.

data.name: SettingsLater
data.value: Settings show once the background service runs.

data.name: RoutesTaken
data.value: Another app (a VPN?) routes all traffic, so jink stands aside.

data.name: NotOnline
data.value: It did not get online in time.

data.name: NotAdministrator
data.value: The service does not run as administrator.

data.name: AlreadyRunning
data.value: Another copy of jink is running.

data.name: NoInterface
data.value: jink could not create its network interface.

data.name: Routes
data.value: jink could not read or change the network routes.

data.name: Capture
data.value: jink could not see or send network traffic.

data.name: MissingDriver
data.value: A file jink needs (WinDivert64.sys) is missing: reinstall jink.

data.name: Driver
data.value: Windows did not load jink's network driver (WinDivert). An antivirus may block it.

data.name: TcpTimestamps
data.value: Windows did not turn on TCP timestamps, so some of this strategy's fakes do not work.

data.name: BadStrategy
data.value: This strategy does not work with these settings.

data.name: NotSavedService
data.value: jink could not save its settings.

data.name: RoutesLeft
data.value: jink could not remove all of its network routes.

data.name: NoAnswer
data.value: The background service did not answer.

data.name: NotUnderstood
data.value: The background service answered something this app does not understand. Reinstall jink.

data.name: UnknownStrategy
data.value: The service does not know the strategy {0}. Reinstall jink.

data.name: EntryIpAddress
data.value: an IP address: put it under IPs

data.name: EntryNotAscii
data.value: a non-Latin name: enter its xn-- form

data.name: EntryNoDot
data.value: the ending is missing (youtube.com, not youtube)

data.name: EntryInvalidIp
data.value: not an IP address or network
